ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with high-intensity white pixels (approx. 90% of surface) and low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 10% on trailing edges and focal spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized white contiguous region across both lobes. Black pigmentation band (~15-20 pixel width) along the trailing edge boundary. Isolated dark focal spots observed: one in the mid-section of the left lobe, two vertically stacked below the median notch, and one in the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 115-degree interior vertex angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Right distal tip shows increased amplitude jaggedness compared to left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips; leading edges show straight-to-convex trajectories.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark clusters at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by irregular texture consistent with barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small non-linear indentations and chips along the trailing edge boundary resulting in minor deviations from a smooth geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered high-intensity specular pixel noise from water droplets present across the mid-ventral surface.
